svg.text: STAGE 461 · TOPIC 101 · SVG 105 🎉 · 🎉 HISTORIC 105TH SVG & 925-GUARDRAIL DUAL MILESTONE (P915–P916)
Enterprise SIP RFC 8760 SHA-256 Digest Anti-Downgrade & nc Replay Guard
Eliminating MD5 Bidding-Down GPU Cracking, Unsalted qop-less Hashes & Nonce-Count (nc) Replay Toll Fraud
🎉 105TH SVG & 925 GUARDRAILS
464 Dims · 934 Probes · 903 Tests
❌ Legacy RFC 3261 Digest: MD5 Downgrade & nc Replay Toll Fraud
1. Dual-Stack MD5 Bidding-Down & Missing qop="auth" Cracking
• MITM strips SHA-256 challenge header, forcing legacy MD5 fallback.
• Single GPU cracks MD5 SIP digest hashes at 95+ GH/s in minutes!
• Omitting qop="auth" or using low-entropy cnonce lets rogue servers
feed a static nonce and reverse trunk passwords via rainbow tables!
Result: Trivial Offline Password Recovery & Trunk Takeover
2. Unchecked Nonce-Count (nc) Replay & Multi-Hour Nonce Lifetime
• Client reuses server nonce across INVITEs with nc=00000001..N.
• Without a per-nonce sliding nc bitmap, an attacker copies one
valid Proxy-Authorization header and replays it 1,000+ times to
dial high-cost international toll-fraud numbers for hours!
Result: Zero-Password Cut-and-Paste International Toll Fraud
✅ RFC 8760 SHA-256 Guard (P915) & nc Replay Guard (P916 🎉)
• Strictly blocks algorithm=MD5 downgrade & qop-less auth responses.
• Mandates SHA-256 or SHA-512-256 with qop="auth" / "auth-int".
• Clamps client cnonce CSPRNG entropy to [128, 256] bits.
• 100% defeats MD5 bidding-down & rainbow-table reversal!
clampedMd5DowngradedOrWeakCnonceAuthHandshakes = 0 · cnonce ∈ [128, 256]b
P916 (🎉 925th Guard!) · (nonce, nc) Bitmap & [60, 300]s Stale Guard
• Enforces 64-bit sliding anti-replay bitmap on every (nonce, nc) pair.
• Rejects duplicate nc replay & credential-stuffing bursts in 0ms.
• Clamps server nonce TTL to [60, 300]s (120s nominal) with seamless
stale=true rotation — zero user password prompts!
clampedReplayedNcOrCredentialStuffingAttempts = 0 · Nonce TTL ∈ [60, 300]s
